messages:
mira-cs: Quick heads-up — KuiperAI has an EU product demo next Tue 07:00 UTC. They asked for a temporary regional surge and both a header allowlist + customer accelerator CIDR so their edge can sign requests. Renewal flagged as high risk if demo underperforms.

jason-ops: Copy. What multiplier and window length? Header format or exact token pattern? CIDR? Preferred region?

mira-cs: Product requests +2x baseline QPS for 8 hours (2026-09-21T07:00Z -> 2026-09-21T15:00Z). Header whitelist and CIDR: header X-Partner-Key pattern "^kuiper-prod-[a-f0-9]{12}$" and CIDR 203.0.113.0/26 for their accelerator. Route primarily to eu-west-1, fallback to eu-north-1. Also want automatic fallback to a compact quantized model if p95 latency > 420ms sustained for 90s. Auto-revoke after window. Please tag renewal_risk=high.

emma-eng: We can implement header regex and CIDR. Compact fallback model available: kuiper-compact-q4_1. Recommend fallback condition as you said, and add alerting for error_rate > 1% or p95 > 350ms. Suggest ephemeral capacity bump (medium) to reduce tail.

jason-ops: Drafting infra CR. Will include rate_multiplier=2, window, header+cidr allowlist, region_policy pref eu-west-1 fallback eu-north-1, fallback_model, alert thresholds, ephemeral bump, and auto-revoke. Any token caps?

mira-cs: No per-token cap requested. AM asked for request-id capture for any 5xxs and to collect a short customer diary. Rachel (AM) will follow post-demo.

jason-ops: CR snippet: ```json
{\n  "customer": "kuiper-ai",\n  "change_request": "CR-2026-0921-kuiper-eu-surge",\n  "window_start": "2026-09-21T07:00:00Z",\n  "duration": "8h",\n  "rate_multiplier": 2,\n  "region_policy": {"preferred": ["eu-west-1"], "fallback": ["eu-north-1"]},\n  "allowlist": {"header": "X-Partner-Key", "pattern": "^kuiper-prod-[a-f0-9]{12}$", "cidr": "203.0.113.0/26"},\n  "fallback_model": "kuiper-compact-q4_1",\n  "fallback_condition": "p95_latency > 420ms for 90s",\n  "alerts": "error_rate > 1% OR p95 > 350ms",\n  "ephemeral_pool": "medium-burst",\n  "auto_revoke": true\n}```

emma-eng: LGTM. I'll stage the routing rule and flag the compact model in the catalog. Jason — please attach runbook steps for rollback and enable trace capture when fallback triggers.

jason-ops: Change request CR-2026-0921-kuiper-eu-surge created and queued. Pushing config to infra now and scheduling auto-revoke at 2026-09-21T15:00:00Z.

infra-bot: Change CR-2026-0921-kuiper-eu-surge applied: rate_multiplier=2 (eu-west-1 preferred), header allowlist X-Partner-Key added with regex ^kuiper-prod-[a-f0-9]{12}$, CIDR 203.0.113.0/26 added, ephemeral_pool=medium-burst allocated, fallback model kuiper-compact-q4_1 enabled with condition p95>420ms for 90s, alerts configured. Auto-revoke scheduled at 2026-09-21T15:00:00Z.

rachel-am: Noted — I'll tag account renewal_risk=high and schedule a post-demo touch. Mira please capture the customer diary, any 5xx request-ids, and latency samples; post a short summary here within 24h after the demo.

mira-cs: Will collect logs, sample traces, and a brief customer diary and share back within 24h. :spiral_notepad:
